policy: Research-only. Preserve every previous editorial choice. Do not promote media to production from metadata or hash alone. Zero paid storage, no owner contact.
provenance: Derived from PR #2116 canonical batches 001–005; subtracted the 142 main-approved covers after PR #2119. Prioritized 100 uniquely pinned previously selected Commons file titles with compatible claimed licence, credit, dimensions and SHA1.
requirements: Read only exact original Commons upload URLs; never search by generic site name or silently replace approved candidates.
Stream original bytes with a per-file cap and verify against Commons metadata SHA1. A valid hash verifies bytes, not photographer copyright.
Do not infer freedom of panorama from photographer grant. Modern artwork, protected interiors and heritage restrictions need independent review.
Keep image files out of ephemeral Action artifacts and do not claim downloaded photos are permanently archived until approved derivatives are committed.
Do not publish or update approved Place media through this queue.
